observations: Bare engine assembly (block + head, no transmission visible) sitting on bare ground amid other engines in what looks like a scrapyard/parts lot.
Engine has valve cover, alternator, pulleys, hoses, wiring loom and a sensor cluster attached; no intake manifold with injectors or throttle body clearly visible in any shot.
A white barcode/parts sticker is visible on the engine block in photos 0 and 1 but the text is too small/blurry to read.
A small blue sticker and faint marks are visible on the valve cover in photo 2, but no legible engine code (e.g. 1AZ-FE, 2AZ-FE) or VIN plate is visible.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI UCHENNA' overlays all three photos; no video, no startup clip, no dipstick/oil shot, no compression test shown.
Surface grime, oxidation and old oil residue are visible on the block and pulleys, consistent with a used yard engine, not a freshly tested unit.
Seller's new message is text only, reasserting prior claims; no new photo or video was provided.

No clear seal, tamper sticker, or factory marks shown; valve cover bolts and gasket are not photographed close enough to confirm untouched state.

risks.if_unproven: priced as generic unverified-fitment Toyota 4-cyl engine, lowest matching variant

risks.proof: Full 360° photo set including intake side, bottom (oil pan/starter), and rear (bellhousing) of the engine.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the engine code stamp on the block (to confirm 1AZ-FE/2AZ-FE and exact fitment).
Short video of the engine running/idling with sound audible (to support 'tested, no knock').
Photos of the intake manifold side, bellhousing, and oil pan underside to confirm completeness.
Any import/customs document or dealer tag showing Belgium origin and mileage.
response.reason: A verbal reaffirmation with no new photo or video does not change the evidence; the engine's running condition, exact code, and completeness remain unproven, so it is still priced at worst case as an unverified-condition used engine pending the listed proofs.
